exposure: number of abnormal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) values
plasma glucose levels measured during the OGTT
serum C-peptide level before breakfast and 1 and 2 h after breakfast
cohort: The study included 113 patients with gestational diabetes, with a mean age of 34.2 years and mean pre-gestational BMI of 23.6 kg/m2.
finding: Pre-gestational BMI, AUC for serum C-peptide level, and HbA1c level were identified as independent predictors for insulin requirement during pregnancy in patients with gestational diabetes.
